children: Shares of Purple Style Labs, the parent company of luxury fashion platform Pernia’s Pop-Up Shop, made a weak debut on Dalal Street on Monday, 07 September despite the company’s public issue receiving overall subscription.

The stock opened at Rs 535 on the NSE, a 6.96 per cent discount to its issue price of Rs 575 per share. On the BSE, it debuted at Rs 539, down 6.26 per cent from the issue price. The stock was trading at a 2 per cent discount in the grey market ahead of listing.

The Rs 680-crore IPO was subscribed 1.29 times, with investors bidding for around 88.66 lakh shares against 68.49 lakh shares on offer. Retail investors led demand with 1.58 times subscription, followed by qualified institutional buyers (QIBs) at 1.43 times. The non-institutional investor (NII) portion was undersubscribed at 84 per cent.

The issue, which was open from August 31 to September 2, comprised entirely a fresh issue of 1.18 crore equity shares, with no offer-for-sale component. The price band was fixed at Rs 546-575 per share.

Ahead of the IPO, Purple Style Labs raised Rs 306 crore from anchor investors on August 28. It allotted 53.21 lakh shares at Rs 575 apiece to 10 anchor investors, including Morgan Stanley Asia, BofA Securities Europe, Integrated Core Strategies, ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund, Jupiter India Fund, Aditya Birla Sun Life Insurance Company, ITI Mutual Fund and Singularity Equity Fund I.

A substantial portion of the fresh issue proceeds will be deployed towards the company’s subsidiary, PSL Retail. According to the IPO documents, the funds will be used to meet lease liabilities for Experience Centers and back-end offices in India, along with sales and marketing expenses and general corporate purposes.

Purple Style Labs operates Pernia’s Pop-Up Shop, a multi-brand luxury fashion platform offering designer apparel, jewellery and accessories across its digital platform and physical Experience Centers.
The company currently operates 14 Experience Centers, including 12 in metropolitan cities, while also reaching customers through online channels, events and exhibitions.
The company reported revenue from operations of around Rs 557.8 crore in FY26, compared with Rs 489.9 crore in FY25.
However, profitability remained under pressure. Purple Style Labs’ net loss widened to around Rs 285.3 crore in FY26 from Rs 188.3 crore in the previous financial year.
